nodes.label: autoresearchclaw — PRJ93 critique-revise operating manual
nodes.rationale: Distilled from the AutoResearchClaw stage architecture so the full source analysis is not needed to run the loop. Not auto-loaded — must be named in the phase prompt. Where it conflicts with PRJ93_RULES.md, PRJ93_RULES.md wins and the conflict is flagged rather than resolved.

nodes.label: Five human gates (stop-and-ask)
nodes.rationale: Methodology change, dropping/adding a cited paper, rerunning an experiment, final figure types and any Overleaf push each stop the loop. One gate per question — never batched — so the human decision stays legible. Two further gates (evidence base before reading effort; research question before methodology) are candidates, not adopted, and must be raised rather than enforced. Never write outside brain/.

nodes.label: Critique-revise loop (draft -> 3 critiques -> synthesis -> revise -> test)
nodes.rationale: Hard cap of 2 revision rounds; on the third failure stop and report what still fails with a stated caveat.

nodes.label: One separate call per review role (no single-call multi-persona)
nodes.rationale: Three personas sharing a single context share every blind spot and cannot disagree in any load-bearing way — named as the single largest defect in the source system and the reason the loop is structured this way. Each role sees the draft section and its result files, and nothing from the other roles.

nodes.label: Fourth synthesis call — reconcile without flattening
nodes.rationale: Takes the strongest elements from each critique rather than compromising between them and preserves genuine disagreements, stating which evidence would settle a conflict. No role may veto; the synthesiser may discard a critique but must say it did and why.

nodes.label: Role A — Methodologist
nodes.rationale: Audits whether the work supports the claim independent of how it is written: internal/external validity, baseline fairness (real contest vs strawman), ablation separability, reproducibility, protocol leakage.

nodes.label: Role B — Statistician
nodes.rationale: Audits whether the numbers mean what the sentences say: CIs on every table, n>1 with the count stated, tests matched to design, effect size not just p, survivorship (both conditional and unconditional metrics), non-zero variance across conditions, stated denominators.

nodes.label: Role C — Claim auditor
nodes.rationale: Audits the join between text and evidence sentence by sentence: unnamed supporting metric is blocking, a prose number absent from a result file is blocking, verb strength must match evidence strength, limitations stated once rather than hedged throughout, citations must not all sit in the front matter.

nodes.label: T1-T14 advance-vs-revise tests
nodes.rationale: Every test is pass/fail with no partial credit or judgement call, so the gate cannot be argued around. Any blocking failure means revise; advisory failures may pass with a stated caveat. T1-T14 are necessary, not sufficient — they catch defects but do not score against the DS591 rubric.

nodes.label: T1 — every number traces to a brain/log/*result*.md file
nodes.rationale: The load-bearing test: a number without a traceable source is the failure mode that destroys a dissertation's credibility and no amount of good prose compensates. If T1 fails, stop revising prose and fix the trace first. The path goes in a LaTeX comment beside the number.

nodes.label: Failure and pivot signals (one signal, one action)
nodes.rationale: Each signal has exactly one prescribed action to be taken without deliberation. No-real-data is a hard stop overriding everything. Saturation and flat ablations mean the experiment design, not the writing, is the problem — raise a methodology gate. Identical byte-level metrics across conditions is a bug, never a null result. A revision under 80% of original word count is discarded because losing content silently is worse than not revising. A contradiction between sections is blocking and resolved before anything else.

nodes.label: Anti-patterns inherited from the source system
nodes.rationale: Computing a quality signal and not branching on it manufactures the appearance of rigour and is worse than no signal. Backfilling to hit a count makes the count carry no information. Degrading the hard stop into a 'proceed with a warning label' path converts the only real quality gate into a footnote — there is no graceful-degradation mode. Placeholder output survives into the artifact. Verifying without writing back means the uncorrected file is what gets submitted. Absence-by-grep is weak evidence and must be labelled an unverified negative.

nodes.label: Adopted drafting rules (§7)
nodes.rationale: Claim bounding, statistical honesty (no superiority claim without a p-value; reframe as comparable where it does not win), honest retitling (an accurate title on a negative result marks better than an aspirational one), no invented numbers under pressure, and reimplementable method sections.

nodes.label: Role definitions are adapted, not validated
nodes.rationale: Distilled from a system whose own review stage was its weakest component and never run against a real PRJ93 chapter; the first use is to be treated as a trial and what the roles missed recorded in brain/ledger/phase_state.md. The file also cannot mark a draft, has no PRJ93 word targets, and does not know the project's state.
